## Purpose

Describe the problem and the outcome of this change.

## Change type

- [ ] Protocol or schema
- [ ] Reference implementation
- [ ] Conformance or test vector
- [ ] Documentation or governance
- [ ] Security fix coordinated under `SECURITY.md`

## Review checklist

- [ ] I read `PRINCIPLES.md`, `SCOPE.md`, and `IPR-POLICY.md`.
- [ ] The change remains independently implementable without an AgentIsOK-hosted dependency.
- [ ] I considered security, privacy, accessibility, and ecosystem-concentration effects.
- [ ] I updated schemas, profiles, examples, threat analysis, and tests where relevant.
- [ ] If I changed protocol objects, I regenerated examples and vectors with `agent-clearance-generate`.
- [ ] I identified copied or adapted third-party material and its license.
- [ ] My commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.

## Interoperability evidence

Explain how another implementation can reproduce or test the behavior. For a normative change, identify the second implementation path or the experiment needed to establish one.

## Risks and alternatives

Describe failure behavior, compatibility effects, and alternatives considered, especially existing standards that could be composed instead.
